content.comment_body: Hello, is anyone able to explain the easiest way to change the T value in an off-delay block using the personalized web server of [product_name]?
You can achieve this by sending the block parameter to the VM area through parameter VM mapping.
Thank you, that's exactly what I needed—a little guidance in the right direction helped me resolve it!

analysis.insight_summary: The user wanted to adjust the 'T' value of an off-delay block using the personalized web server on [product_name]. The main usability insight is that users benefit from simple, direct ways to change control parameters through the web interface. Mapping parameters to the VM area is essential, and with proper guidance, the process is straightforward.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a quick and uncomplicated approach to modify block settings like timers via the web server interface.
